name: vuio
description: Browse, search and cast your VuIO media library from Claude.
long_description:
Connects Claude to a VuIO media server on your network. Search the library, browse folders, build playlists, and cast to DLNA, Chromecast and AirPlay devices.

This bundle runs `vuio mcp`, which bridges Claude's stdio connection to a VuIO server that is already running. It does not start a server or open the library database itself — point it at the machine that does.

server_url.title: Server address
server_url.description: Where your VuIO server answers, for example http://nas.local:8080

token_file.title: Management token file
token_file.description: The admin.token file beside your server's config. Needed only if the server requires authentication.
